cases.q: 各个区域的故障率排名
cases.sql:
SELECT p.region, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(f.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.plant_id), 4) AS fault_rate
FROM dim_plant p
LEFT JOIN fact_device_fault f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id
GROUP BY p.region
ORDER BY fault_rate DESC, p.region
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.region AS region, ROUND(1.0*COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT fl.plant_id),2) AS avg_fault_per_plant FROM fact_device_fault fl JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = fl.plant_id GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY avg_fault_per_plant DESC, p.region

JOIN dim_plant p ON g.plant_id = p.plant_id

cases.q: 本月发电量环比上月增长最多的 5 个省份
cases.sql:
SELECT province,
       ROUND((cur_gen - prev_gen) / prev_gen, 4) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM (
    SELECT p.province AS province,
           SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur_gen,
           SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-07' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev_gen
    FROM fact_daily_generation f
    JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) IN ('2026-08', '2026-07')
    GROUP BY p.province
)
WHERE prev_gen > 0
ORDER BY mom_growth_rate DESC, province
LIMIT 5
cases.expected_sql: SELECT province, ROUND((cur - prev) / prev, 4) AS mom FROM (SELECT p.province AS province, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-07' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation f JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id GROUP BY p.province) ORDER BY (cur - prev) / prev DESC, province LIMIT 5
